in_hebrew.name: Ag
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ageless, Venerable, Wise
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ag הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Ag is the name of a god associated with the earth, fertility, and longevity. The name Ag is derived from the Greek word ‘ágos’ which means ‘noble,’ ‘honorable,’ or ‘ageless.’ In Christianity, Ag can be interpreted as a symbol of wisdom, venerability, and eternal life.
